ms.promise:
・Suite of common technical indicators, which work off of OHLCV ticks.
・Twilio & Slack integrations, along with tying in relevant notification triggers into the framework.
・Auto-Cancellation/Take Profit jobs to automatically trigger closing orders
ms.criteria:
・Orders placed by Breeze are automatically cancelled when the order is not settled after a specific time limit provided in the Breeze config. Ex: 60 minutes
・Assets bought through Breeze are automatically sold when the overall trade has an un-realized profit amount specified in the Breeze config. Ex: 5%
・On failures for either of the above, Breeze will continue to retry until the expected result is obtained. This assumes there are no underlying issues/bugs within Breeze itself.
